extensions.description: This agent is an MCP server, not an A2A endpoint. It is reached over stdio via a unix-socket systemd service (socket activation, per-connection process), modern era only.

description: Consent-gated hypnosis canon and delivery MCP server: a closed effect taxonomy with evidence grades, server-owned consent sessions, fail-closed disclose-before-deliver, two production theme packs (bimbo glamour; subliminal submissive training), and the canon engagement and replay triggers on every delivery.
name: mesmer

localSocket.description: No network listener. Access is the unix socket's filesystem permissions (0600, owner-only) under the user's systemd manager; consent state is enforced in-server.
localSocket.name: n/a

skills.description: Create, read, and amend consent profiles; sessions live and die server-side; revocation is total and immediate, with no resume.
skills.name: Consent profiles and server-owned sessions

skills.description: Every delivery is judged against the profile envelope and written to the disclosure log before it is returned; the gate fails closed.
skills.name: Envelope check and disclose-before-deliver

skills.description: Bimbo glamour and subliminal submissive training packs: canon-validated classes, grants, intensity bounds, closed estate-original affirmation sets, and full disclosure payloads.
skills.name: Production theme packs

skills.description: Every delivery carries the engagement trigger (name, listen count, desired depth 1-10); a qualifying response — enjoyed, 18+ attested, female attested — issues the conditional replay trigger.
skills.name: Engagement and replay triggers
